title: Conversational ADK pipeline: coordinator agent drives plan->sync->simulate->approve->watch->analyze
description: Wire the existing stage modules as ADK tools under one coordinator agent with sub-agents, chatted via adk web. Agent bakes planned values into workflow inputs[].defaultValue and syncs with zeon commit/push; execution stays human-triggered in the Zeon app, agent watches for it. All stage transitions still go through beads_writer so the per-round DAG stays intact.
close_reason: coordinator + 5 sub-agents wired over the existing stage modules; traced end to end

title: Real kinetics run exec_...20260726_012119 is unlinked from round mikmak-mae (run_name predates the round-scoped rename)
description: A physical run of tem1_kinetics_characterization landed on the cloud at 01:55 on 2026-07-26 and pulled down into data/logs/. It executed with run_name 'tem1_kinetics_run', but inputs/mikmak-mae.json now says 'tem1_kinetics_run_mikmak-mae' (run_name became round-scoped so a second round can't claim the first round's execution). So watch_execution won't match them. Also: mikmak-mae is still at stage=planned — it never went through simulate/approve; the run was started straight from the app. Decide whether to link this execution to mikmak-mae by hand or leave it unattributed.
close_reason: operator: that execution was a sim test run directly in the app, deliberately left unattributed. Matching is exact-equality on run_name, so it cannot be picked up by a future round.
